summary: Explains how to configure the automatic generation of unique application form numbers for admission leads, allowing for custom prefixes, suffixes, and starting numbers based on courses or programs.
steps: Navigate to Admission Module > Admission Setup > Admission Master.
Select the specific course or program for which to apply the numbering (e.g., "School of Engineering") or choose "All" for a universal setting.
business_rules: The system automatically assigns unique numbers to new applications based on the configured prefix, starting number, and suffix.
The counter for application numbers auto-updates with each new lead added.
Numbering can be configured separately for different courses or programs, or universally for all.
important_notes: This setup ensures a unique identifier for each application form, crucial for tracking and management.
questions: How do I set up automatic application numbering in the Admission module?
Can I use different application numbering formats for different academic programs?
Where do I configure the prefix and suffix for application numbers?
How does the application number counter update automatically?
